title: BH loads in a game, draws its overlays and opens its settings

steps.check: the game is a new Sorceress in the Rogue Encampment, in Normal
the info panel names the area at the top right
the Settings and Codex buttons sit at the bottom left
the settings hotkey opens the settings window at the top left
the window has the game's frame around it
the window opens on the Map tab
leaving saves and returns to the main menu
